description: This line plot illustrates the loss reduction over training iterations for six different model configurations, with the y-axis representing “Loss” on a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, and the x-axis representing “#Iteration” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1,400,000. The plot contains six colored lines, each corresponding to a model variant as indicated in the legend: a purple line for “Vanilla,” a blue line for “StrmLLM (n=64),” an orange line for “SepLLM (n=64),” a green line for “SepLLM (n=64, H),” a red line for “SepLLM (n=64, H/T),” and a dark blue line for “SepLLM (n=128).” All lines begin at a high loss value near 3.4 at iteration 0 and exhibit a rapid initial decline, followed by a slower, more gradual decrease as iterations increase. By iteration 1,400,000, all models converge to a loss value near 2.5, with the “Vanilla” model showing the lowest final loss among the six, while the “SepLLM (n=64)” model shows the highest final loss among the SepLLM variants. The “SepLLM (n=128)” model demonstrates a slightly higher loss than the “SepLLM (n=64)” model at the beginning but converges to a similar final value.
